lessons.title: Your First Boxes

play.targetObjective: Split a 3×3 grid into boxes that match their numbers.
stepByStep: Pick a number.
Count out that many squares next to it.
Draw a box around them. One number in each box.
play.kidTip: Count the squares inside your box. It must be the same as the number.
play.audioPrompt: Split the grid into boxes. Each box has one number, and that many squares.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Every puzzle is solved by boxes that fit only one way, so the rule is practised, not luck.

play.kidTip: Say the times facts for the number: 6 is 1 × 6 and 2 × 3. Each fact is a shape.

lessons.title: Only One Reaches
lessons.concept: A Square Only One Number Can Reach

play.targetObjective: Find squares only one number can reach.
stepByStep: Find an empty square that looks hard to reach.
Check which numbers could stretch a box over it.
If only one can, its box must cover that square.
play.kidTip: Find an empty square only one number can reach. That number's box covers it.
play.audioPrompt: Split the grid into boxes. Each box has one number, and that many squares.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Every puzzle needs at least one square that only one number can reach.

lessons.title: Shared Squares

play.kidTip: If every box for a number covers the same squares, those squares are its. Nobody else can have them.
play.audioPrompt: Split the grid into boxes. Each box has one number, and that many squares.

lessons.pedagogyTip: Every puzzle needs at least one shared-squares step; nothing needs a guess.
